mechanism_narrative: A persistently elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates for future cash flows, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate profitability and investor risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% MoM, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), labor market weakness signals economic slowdown and reduced consumer spending, depressing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market slowdown regimes (HOUST YoY growth < 0.5%), reduced residential construction weakens overall demand for goods and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST YoY growth < 0.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) indicates persistent inflation forcing restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.
